title: Take spacing, radii, and durations from foundations tokens in UI files

facts.note: Repository-level prerequisite, not a selector on the judged file: at least one design root must exist anywhere in the repository (self-scoping). Needs a repo-level existence check. The judged UI file may live anywhere in that repository, inside or outside the design root.

values: UI file (any format that carries style declarations)
facts.note: Normative scope is UI files generally, anywhere in the repository; there is no exhaustive extension allowlist. Special case from the source: in .ts/.mts files only HTML authored in string/template/tagged-template literals is judged. Identifying UI files across formats needs a UI-file classifier. Implementation coverage (not normative applicability): the graph edge reason currently lists .tsx, .jsx, .html, .css, .ts, .mts as detector-supported kinds. Test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*) and vendored/build directories excluded.

Excludes only files under the design root's tokens/foundations layer (first directory beneath the design root). Includes design-system primitives, components, templates and all UI files outside the design root.

values: bun_design_system_detector: hardcoded spacing/inset/radius length or duration
facts.note: Validator finding over the UI file's declarations (all declarations, not only changed ones).

fires: A component in the design system declares `padding: 13px`.
A UI file outside the design root sets `gap` to a bare number such as 8 in a JSX style object.
A .ts file renders HTML from a template literal containing `style="margin: 12px"` or a `<style>` block with `border-radius: 6px`.
doesNotFire: The repository has no design root.
The file lives in the tokens/foundations layer.
A custom property definition such as `--space-3: 12px`, wherever it lives.
A width, height, or font-size declaration.
A test file (*.test.*, *.spec.*) or a vendored/build directory.
Code, a comment, or a regex literal in a .ts file (not HTML literal text).

given: The repository has a design root (`design`, `design_system`, or `design-system` dir; its first subdirectory names the layer) and you edit a UI file anywhere outside its tokens/foundations layer
when: the file declares `margin`, `padding`, `gap`, `inset`, `top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left`, `border-radius`, or `transition`/`animation` (CSS, JSX style objects where a bare number is a length, or inline/`<style>` HTML in .ts/.mts literals)
then: Take those lengths > 1px and non-zero durations from foundations tokens (`var(--…)`); never hardcode them.
prefer: Use the existing foundations scale for spacing, inset, radius, and duration.
During GREEN: reuse the nearest existing semantic or scale token.
During GREEN: add a foundation value only when the design genuinely needs a distinct one.
During GREEN: change only the style declaration the acceptance needs.
avoid: One-off tokens that merely rename a hardcoded literal.
unless: Value is 0 or 1px (hairlines are not design decisions).
Custom property definition (`--space-3: 12px`), wherever it lives.
File is in the tokens/foundations layer.
No design root in the repository: no system to connect to yet.
why: Spacing and motion are an interface's rhythm; each hardcoded `13px` is a new step on a scale nobody chose, eroding it one component at a time.
evidence: bun_design_system_detector reports no hardcoded spacing/inset/radius length > 1px or non-zero duration in affected UI files.
Prove: the current visual or behavioral acceptance passes, and affected UI values come from the declared foundations (`var(--…)` references to tokens defined once in foundations).
verifier_detail: Properties judged: margin, padding, gap, inset, top, right, bottom, left, border-radius (lengths > 1px); transition, animation (non-zero durations).
A bare number in a JSX style object for those properties counts as a length (and is then subject to the same > 1px threshold).
In .ts/.mts files, judge inline `style="…"` attributes and `<style>` text in HTML authored in string, template, and tagged-template literals.
Only literal text is judged in .ts/.mts files: code, comments, and regex literals are never read as declarations; a value spanning a `${…}` interpolation is judged on its literal chunks alone.

design_root: a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`. The first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`. A repository with no design root is not judged (self-scoping): there is no system to connect to yet.
visual_token: a spacing, radius, or motion value defined once in foundations and referenced as `var(--…)`.

Scope: hardcoded lengths and durations in spacing, radius, and motion declarations across UI files (any format), including the design system's own primitives and components; the tokens/foundations layer defines these values and is not scanned. Current detector coverage (per graph edge) is .tsx, .jsx, .html, .css, .ts, .mts; this is implementation coverage, not a limit on applicability.
Exclusions: test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*) and vendored/build directories never scanned; 0 and 1px allowed; custom property definitions not flagged; widths/heights/font sizes out of scope.
audit: Bun realization of `coder.design.token-hardcoded` and of the raw-pixel part of `coder.design.foundations`.
Source name: UI files take spacing, radii, and durations from foundations
